capabilities.purpose: Stage new data with file/sheet/row lineage before trust decisions.

capabilities.purpose: Provide structural, row, dataset, population and control-total checks with quarantine and fail-closed trust boundaries.

limitations: Prefer SQL. Isolated tested Python is allowed only when SQL would be unsafe or materially less clear; never duplicate the same trusted formula.

capabilities.purpose: Render KPIs, charts, filters, tables, insights and exports from project presentation configuration without editing frontend core.
limitations: Full browser/offline/accessibility proof remains a release gate.

capabilities.purpose: Provide the reusable FastAPI/Uvicorn application boundary bound only to 127.0.0.1 under the standard user.
